entry.title: open-telemetry/opentelemetry-dotnet-contrib - Releases - 2026-11-04
entry.content:
Instrumentation.ConfluentKafka-0.4.0-alpha.1

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Instrumentation.ConfluentKafka v0.4.0-alpha.1

    • Fixed unbounded memory use caused by long string message keys being recorded
      in full in the messaging.kafka.message.key span attribute. Keys longer than
      256 characters are now truncated.
      (#5859)

    • Added the UseCreationContextAsParent option to
      ConfluentKafkaInstrumentedConsumerBuilderOptions. When enabled, the
      process span created by ConsumeAndProcessMessageAsync uses the message
      creation context (extracted from the message headers) as its parent instead
      of only linking to it, as allowed by the messaging semantic conventions.
      (#5510)

    See CHANGELOG for details.

Instrumentation.Wcf-1.20.1-beta.2

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Instrumentation.Wcf v1.20.1-beta.2

    • Fixed an issue where a late reply or the telemetry timeout for a failed
      outgoing duplex request could stop the client activity a second time and
      record reply data on it.
      (#5791)

    • Fixed an ArgumentOutOfRangeException from the telemetry timeout timer,
      which could terminate the process, for outgoing duplex requests with a send
      timeout longer than about 49 days, such as TimeSpan.MaxValue.
      (#5841)

    • Fixed exceptions thrown while completing timed out outgoing duplex requests
      escaping the timeout timer's thread, where they could terminate the process.
      They are now reported through the OpenTelemetry-Instrumentation-Wcf event
      source.
      (#5841)

    • Fixed outgoing duplex requests that never received a reply, and their
      activities, being tracked indefinitely when their channel was closed,
      aborted or faulted. They are now completed when the channel goes away.
      (#5841)

    • Fixed an issue where outgoing requests that share an
      HttpRequestMessageProperty instance leaked traceparent, tracestate and
      baggage HTTP headers from one call to later calls.
      (#5860)

    See CHANGELOG for details.

Exporter.InfluxDB-1.0.0-alpha.17

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Exporter.InfluxDB v1.0.0-alpha.17

    • Fixed invalid line protocol produced by certain metric tag keys and values.
      (#5842)

    • Limited HTTP write responses buffered by the InfluxDB exporter to 1 MiB.
      Larger responses cause the export to fail.
      (#5861)

    See CHANGELOG for details.
